project_info.theme: Late-1990s flash portrait in a high-rise apartment
project_info.color_palette: burgundy, light gray, white, charcoal and city-light bokeh

main_subject.detail: Adult woman with medium-brown hair in a loose bun, a few face-framing strands, full brows, winged eyeliner and light pink lipstick, seated on a light-gray sofa in a non-transparent burgundy lace strapless dress. Do not reproduce the named celebrity likeness.
main_subject.style: dreamy grainy direct-flash editorial with realistic skin texture

composition_elements.layout: 3:4 close-up at eye level, sofa and night skyline behind

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: direct on-camera flash at 5600K with low ambient city light
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: crisp flash highlights, soft high-contrast shadows, grain and late-night atmosphere

technical_specs.render_style: 35mm point-and-shoot film camera, direct flash, late-1990s editorial snapshot
technical_specs.optics: eye-level close-up, visible grain and moderate depth of field

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a late-1990s or Year 2000 dreamy grainy direct-flash close-up editorial portrait of a generic adult woman seated on a light gray sofa in a high-rise apartment at night. She has medium-brown very long hair pulled into a loose bun with a few strands framing the face, full brows, winged eyeliner, light pink lipstick and a serious yet calm expression looking directly into camera. She wears a short non-transparent dark burgundy strapless corset-style textured lace dress and small silver dangling earrings. Her right hand rests on her stomach and her left arm rests along the sofa back. Behind her is a large window showing illuminated city lights, with a white pillow on the right. Direct camera flash illuminates skin, clothing, jewelry and hair, creating crisp highlights and visible film grain. Preserve a sophisticated adult fashion editorial, not a public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, transparent dress, altered face likeness
